"""Run bounded source-identity validation sequentially, retaining complete output."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys
repo=Path('/Users/tdenisenko/code/logex')
root=Path(sys.argv[1]); root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
def out(c): return subprocess.check_output(c,cwd=repo,text=True).strip()
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
record={'head':out(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']),'branch':out(['git','branch','--show-current']),'toolchain':out(['rustc','-Vv']),'runner_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'checks':[]}
(root/'initial.patch').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--binary'],cwd=repo))
commands=[('fmt',['cargo','fmt','--all']),('clippy',['cargo','clippy','--workspace','--all-targets','--locked','--','-D','warnings']),('storage',['cargo','test','-p','logex-storage','--lib','--locked']),('index',['cargo','test','-p','logex-index','--lib','--locked']),('native',['cargo','test','-p','logex-query','--lib','--locked','native::tests::']),('background',['cargo','test','-p','logex-node','--locked','background::tests::'])]
for name,cmd in commands:
 log=root/(name+'.log'); started=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 with log.open('w') as f: result=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=repo,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env=os.environ|{'TMPDIR':'/private/tmp'})
 record['checks'].append({'name':name,'command':cmd,'exit':result.returncode,'started_at':started,'finished_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'log':str(log),'log_sha256':sha(log)})
 patch = subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--binary'],cwd=repo)
 (root/'final.patch').write_bytes(patch)
 record['checks'][-1]['source_patch_sha256_after_check'] = hashlib.sha256(patch).hexdigest()
 assert out(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']) == record['head'], 'HEAD changed during validation'
 (root/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(name,'exit',result.returncode,flush=True)
 if result.returncode: sys.exit(result.returncode)
(root/'final.patch').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--binary'],cwd=repo))
print('All focused checks passed',flush=True)
